acceptance_criteria: Verify AUTO_PRD_STRICT=1 with invalid MaxBatchSize exits before TUI starts
Verify error message clearly mentions AUTO_PRD_STRICT enabled
Verify exit code is 1 for strict mode errors
Verify AUTO_PRD_STRICT=1 with valid MaxBatchSize starts TUI normally
Verify no AUTO_PRD_STRICT with invalid MaxBatchSize logs warning and starts TUI with default value
